row.label: Code
row.cites: {count, plural, one {# cited range} other {# cited ranges}}

cite.stale: This file changed after the document was written, so these may not be the lines it meant.
cite.unknown: Atlas could not check whether this file changed after the document was written.
cite.beyond: The document cites {lines}, and this file now ends at line {last}.
cite.none: The document names this file and cites no lines.

state.gone: {path} is not in the connected code folder. It was moved, renamed or deleted after the document was written.
state.askToFind: Ask the agent to find it
state.notConnected: No code folder is connected to this project, so Atlas cannot read {path}.
state.accessLost: The connected code folder is not where it was, so Atlas cannot read {path}.
state.secret: Atlas does not read {path}, because files with that name hold keys or passwords.
state.outside: {path} points outside the connected code folder, so Atlas did not read it.
state.tooLarge: {path} is larger than {limit}, so Atlas does not read it here.
state.notText: {path} is not text, so there is nothing to read here.
state.changed: This file changed after Atlas read it.
state.otherSystem: Atlas reads code in place on macOS and Linux only. Copy the path to open the file yourself.

branch.removed: {count, plural, one {# line removed here} other {# lines removed here}}

web.title: Reading code needs the desktop app
web.body: A browser can open only the folder you chose, and the code is outside it. The desktop app reads the code folder connected on this computer.
